P.name: Feline Friendship
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Yuumi's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}}} and become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Upon hitting them with the basic attack or ''{{ai|Prowling Projectile|Yuumi}}'', or upon a ''{{ai|Final Chapter|Yuumi}}'' hit on ally champions while ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'', the buff is consumed to {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|20 + (110-20)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}. If she is ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally or does so within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally, '''Yuumi''' grants them 2 <!--PFT:Increased to 3 on champion kills?--> permanent ''Friendship'' stacks whenever they kill enemy champions or minions. The ally with the highest ''Friendship'' stacks becomes '''Yuumi's''' ''Best Friend'', which empowers her abilities with additional effects while she is ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to them.

Q.name: Prowling Projectile
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' fires an errant missile in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit. If the target is a champion, they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|Attached}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for up to {{fd|1.35}} seconds to steer the missile at a slower speed. After being in flight for the same duration, the missile accelerates in its current direction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds to deal increased damage and apply a stronger slow against champions that decays to 20% over 2 seconds.
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} ''Prowling Projectile'' always applies its enhanced slow against champions and hitting a champion grants her ''Best Friend'' {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for 5 seconds, increased by {{pp|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 100|key=%|key1=%|type=''Anchor's'' critical strike chance|color=critical strike chance}}.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Bonus Magic Damage On-Hit|{{ap|10 to 20 6}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Magic Damage On-Hit|{{ap|10*1.75 to 20*1.75 6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.75}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: You and Me!
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Yuumi''' is {{tip|attached}}, she is {{tip|untargetable}} (except by {{tip|turrets}} and inbound {{tip|projectile|projectiles}}) and casts her abilities from the ''Anchor's'' position, empowering them with additional effects.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, then upon completion {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion and {{tip|Attached|attaches}} to them upon arrival, designating them as her ''Anchor''. ''You and Me!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the attachment.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Change of Plan:}} '''Yuumi''' detaches from her ''Anchor'' and {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion to {{tip|attach}} to them, refreshing the recast. She will detach automatically if her ''Anchor'' dies or under {{tt|certain circumstances|See notes}}. If recast without a valid target, '''Yuumi''' will detach and {{tip|dash}} 250-units in the target direction, placing ''You and Me!'' on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.25}}}}-second cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.
W.description4: '''''Yuumi''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash to the ally.''
W.description5: '''Yuumi''' starts with a skill point in ''You and Me!'' and ''{{ai|Prowling Projectile|Yuumi}}'' instead has 6 ranks.
W.description6:
{{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' gains {{as|{{sti|heal and shield power}}}} and her ''Best Friend'' gains {{tip|heal|healing}} {{tip|on-hit}}.


''You and Me!'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if '''Yuumi''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.
W.leveling6:
{{st|Heal and Shield Power|{{ap|4 to 8}}%}}
{{st|Healing On-Hit|{{ap|3 to 7}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}}}}
W.static: {{tt|{{pp|10 to 0 for 3|1;6;11}}|Starts after completing the channel}}

E.name: Zoomies
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds. She also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while the shield holds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Shield|{{ap|65 to 165}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|25 to 35}}% {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}}}}
E.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|Attached}} Bonus:}} ''Zoomies'' affects the ''Anchor'' instead of '''Yuumi''' and additionally restores {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} to the ''Anchor'', increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 for 11|30 to 80|key=%|key1=%|type=''Anchor's'' '''missing''' mana}}|mana}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|20 to 36}}|mana}}|Maximum Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|20*2 to 36*2}}|mana}}}}

R.name: Final Chapter
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' and '''{{ui|Book of Thresholds|Book|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|channel}} for up to {{fd|3.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|ghosted}}, to launch 5 magical waves in the target direction.
R.description2: Allied champions hit by the waves are {{tip|heal|healed}}, with each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} being converted into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for {{fd|1.5}} seconds plus the remaining channel duration instead.
R.description3: Enemies struck by the waves take {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for {{fd|1.25}} seconds. The slow stacks and refreshes on subsequent hits, up to a total strength of 50%. Subsequent waves against enemies hit deal 25% damage.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Magic Damage per Hit|{{ap|75 to 175}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Reduced Damage per Hit|{{ap|75*0.25 to 175*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*0.25}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|75*2 to 175*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*2}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|Attached}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' can steer the direction of the waves if initially cast while attached. ''{{ai|Change of Plan|Yuumi|Detaching}}'' causes her to lose this bonus for the duration. Additionally, ''{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi}}'' can trigger from also hitting allied champions.
R.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} ''Final Chapter's'' heal to the ''Best Friend'' is increased by {{pp|key=%|30 to 60 for 7|6 to 12}}.
R.description6: ''While not {{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}, '''Yuumi''' can move while channeling Final Chapter.''
